written.myAnswer: Mineral nutrition is the absorption and utilization of mineral nutrients by plants for their growth and development.

Macronutrients are mineral elements required by plants in relatively large quantities, such as nitrogen and potassium. Micronutrients are mineral elements required in very small quantities, such as iron and zinc.
Nitrogen is a component of proteins and chlorophyll. Magnesium is a component of chlorophyll and activates many enzymes.
